messages:
morgan: Quick q — thinking about adding an optional top_level `meta` field to streaming events for latency/tracing info. will this break existing clients? cc @devon @ravi

devon: if it's optional it *shouldn't* break most clients, but strongly-typed parsers (go/rust) can fail if they disallow unknown fields. what's the exact shape you're proposing?

morgan: something like:
```json
{"event":"delta","delta":{"role":"assistant","content":"..."},"meta":{"trace_id":"t-123","server_time_ms":164}}
```
(kept small on purpose)

ravi: two quick concerns: 1) clients that map stream lines -> typed structs may reject unknown top-level keys, 2) streaming chunk boundaries must remain exactly the same (don't want partial reassembly changes).

sasha: could we instead emit a separate `meta` event type? we already have `delta`, `done`, `error` — introducing a new event avoids touching `delta` shape. downside: more event types to teach SDKs.

devon: SDK note: js/python clients already ignore unknown fields. go currently toggles DisallowUnknownFields in some builds; rust clients use serde with deny_unknown_fields in a couple places. we should audit and flip to permissive default.

morgan: proposed rollout plan: (A) add `meta` as optional top-level field on `delta` for a short opt-in window, (B) concurrently add a distinct `event: \"meta\"` emission we can phase up, (C) require opt-in header `X-Stream-Proto: v2` for clients who want the new behavior by default.

ravi: i prefer opt-in header. that way old clients get no change and new clients get richer telemetry. also add an integration test that streams with older client shapes to ensure no validation failure server-side.

sasha: agreed on header. action items: devon -> update SDKs to tolerate unknown fields; morgan -> spec doc + example payloads; ravi -> add regression + canary tests; i'll coordinate rollout window with SRE.

devon: i'll open PRs for js/python to ignore unknown fields; for go i'll add a compatibility flag so consumers can opt into strict mode. will target small patch.

morgan: spec snippet i'll add to PR description:
```json
{
  "event": "delta",
  "delta": { "role": "assistant", "content": "hello" },
  "meta": { "trace_id": "t-123", "server_time_ms": 164 }
}
```
behavior notes: clients MUST ignore unknown top-level fields on `delta`. chunk framing and JSON-lines semantics unchanged.

ravi: tiny suggestion — emit a lightweight `meta` heartbeat event every 5s for long-running streams instead of stuffing meta on every delta. less noise. but OK to do both if we keep meta small. also ensure metrics ingestion doesn't assume only old event types.

ci-bot: CI: streaming-contract-spec PR #322 — unit tests passed, flaky test on linux-2. rerun requested.

morgan: thanks — i'll link PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/322 and drop spec draft in #docs.

sasha: :thumbsup: rollout plan: canary 10% dedicated for 48h, monitor 5xx + client-decoded-errors. escalation: pager if >3% error spike or if latency regresses >50ms p90.

devon: also adding a lint rule in infra to detect clients that call `json.Unmarshal` with DisallowUnknownFields turned on — that'll catch breakage early.

ravi: i'll own rollback playbook + alert thresholds. will add automated smoke that verifies old-client compatibility post-deploy.

morgan: summary / owners: morgan -> spec + server PR, devon -> SDKs + lint, ravi -> tests + rollback, sasha -> rollout ops. ping here if blocked.

sasha: cool, thanks all.

morgan: closing the loop — i'll update the PR with the canary schedule and link the SDK PRs once opened.

ci-bot: CI: re-run triggered for PR #322 — linux-2 flaky tests re-evaluating.
